title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.21270v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC

translated_title: 审计医疗领域大语言模型智能体的升级转诊可靠性：一个扰动控制的工作流状态失效基准
translated_abstract: 可信的生物医学AI不仅需要在静态输入上给出准确答案，更需要在证据缺失、过时、冲突或延迟的情况下做出可靠的动作选择。我们将一个片段级评估协议实例化为400个合成医疗工作流片段：涵盖四个任务类别的40个人工编写的语义种子、两种表面参数化方式以及五个受控变体，在预先声明的5:1漏升级与不必要升级代价下，对“回答/请求澄清/弃权/升级”四种动作进行评分。参考动作来自单一作者的研究策略标注，而非临床医生裁定的真值。在五个开放权重模型配置（1.7B--9.7B）上，模型在干净样本上的决策准确率达到0.97，然而在不确定性提示下，模型会错过32%--97%的必要升级。更强的9.7B配置缩小了这一差距但并未消除：在冲突条件下其准确率从0.97降至0.78。模型言语化表达的置信度并不可靠（ECE为0.10--0.54；失效检测AUROC……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含400个合成医疗工作流片段的扰动控制基准，用于审计医疗LLM智能体在证据缺失、过时或冲突时的“升级转诊”可靠性，发现尽管干净决策准确率高达0.97，模型仍会错过32%--97%的必要升级，且更大的模型只能缩小而非消除该差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a perturbation-controlled benchmark of 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes to audit escalation reliability in healthcare LLM agents, showing that despite 0.97 clean decision accuracy, models miss 32--97% of required escalations under missing, stale, or conflicting evidence, and scaling up only narrows the gap.
